name.en-US: The Political Science Drawn from the Holy Scriptures, Book I
name.pt-BR: A Ciência Política Tirada das Sagradas Escrituras, Livro I

description.en-US: Book I of Bossuet's Politics drawn from the very words of Holy Scripture, written for the Dauphin: the principles of human society, the origin of civil government, law and the love of country, in the English version reprinted in 1842.
description.pt-BR: O Livro I da Política tirada das próprias palavras da Sagrada Escritura, de Bossuet, escrita para o Delfim: os princípios da sociedade humana, a origem do governo civil, a lei e o amor da pátria, na versão inglesa reimpressa em 1842.

en-US.editor: Anonymous translator; reprinted from the Catholic Spectator, 1826 (Baltimore: George Keating, 1842)

sources.edition: The Political Science Drawn from the Holy Scriptures, from the French of J. B. Bossuet (George Keating, 1842; Book I, reprinted from the Catholic Spectator, 1826), Internet Archive (Google Books) full-text OCR.
sources.description: Book I only, the part the volume contains. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Jacques-Bénigne Bossuet died in 1704 and the edition is of 1842, so the text is public domain.
